lines.en: Short legs, but quick as anything.
I hug the grass for cover.
Tail stiff out, keeping balance.
I know Jurassic scrub well.
Walking and hunting tender shoots.
Head bobbing as I scan about.
Small, dense steps; steady going.

lines.zh: 稍大点的影子，我就绕开。
lines.en: A bigger shadow and I detour.
For my size, running is my skill.
The grass stirs and I dart off.
Tiny footprints trail behind me.
I walk like a big lizard.

lines.zh: 回头的次数，比往前走还多。
lines.en: I look back more than I go forward.
Under low bushes is safest.
Knees bent, I slip through branches.
Before sunset I must eat more.
My claws grip the dirt.
I hop over this stone.

lines.zh: 蹲在草里，只露一双眼睛。
lines.en: Crouched in grass, only my eyes show.
Each gust makes me twitch.
My small head swivels about.
No predators just now.
I'm chewing a tough leaf.
Footsteps far off — I stay still.
My tail taps the ground softly.
Shade slides over; cooler now.
I'm listening to the insects.

lines.zh: 有只小虫爬过我的背脊。
lines.en: A little bug crawls along my spine.
It's uneasily quiet.
I give a tiny sneeze.
My legs numb; I shift.
My eyes blink rapidly.
Just a little longer, I think.
My belly isn't empty yet.

lines.zh: 你正堵在我钻的草道口。
lines.en: You're blocking my grass tunnel.
First, whether you carry a net.
You're huge; I'll back up.
I don't know you; stay back.
Head tilted, I study your boots.
When you crouch, I get scared.
My eyes won't leave your hands.
Do you eat tender leaves too?
I move, you move — bad.
This distance is fine between us.
Your shadow is enormous.
One gap and I'm through it.
Ouch! That really hurts.
I crouch and tuck my tail in.
My hind legs buckle and I drop into the dirt.
I dive into the grass.
I'm small; I can't take hits.
My squeak goes high and thin.
The pain spins me around.
One hit and I flop down into the grass.

lines.zh: 肋侧破了皮，一碰就抽痛。
lines.en: The skin over my ribs is split and throbs at a touch.
I shuffle off, pausing at each step.
Tender leaves — for me?

lines.zh: 我不敢过去，你再放低些。
lines.en: I daren't come; set it lower.
It smells sweet.
I inch forward a little.
If your hand twitches, I retreat.
The others say it's edible.
First a small test bite.
That mouthful will last me a while.
Don't hurry me; I'm timid.
Eat it and run.
That leaf is bigger than my head.
I'm not greedy; one leaf is enough.
It smells so good I forget fear.
Approach quietly, no noise.
Step back and I'll dare come.
Crumbs fall, and I pick them up.
Hey! I've been knocked askew.
Your steps are too heavy.
I'm small; one bump flips me.
Up on my feet, and off I go.

lines.zh: 一只大脚擦过，我翻了半圈。
lines.en: A big foot grazes me and I tumble half over.
I squeeze past your foot.
I tumble into grass — good cover.
That wasn't a fight, was it?
I let out a startled squeak.
I'm steady now; don't do it again.
That one's tail is lovely.
I bring a tender leaf over.

lines.zh: 她蹭我的脖子，我愣住了。
lines.en: She nuzzles my neck and I freeze.
She runs; I run after.
We're about the same size — a good match.

lines.zh: 草丛深处，是我们的地方。
lines.en: Deep in the grass is our spot.
First I nuzzle her neck.
Two little dinosaurs, huddled close.
Let spring not be too short.
The nest needs soft soil.
A seed on the ground.
I pick it up and chew.
This little piece is one bite.

lines.zh: 我藏食的地方，自己都忘。
lines.en: I forget where I cache food.
Small or not, I'll take it.
I hold it in my foreclaws and nibble.
Whose fallen fruit? Mine.
I carry it back into the grass.

lines.zh: 啃了半天，只磨出一个白印。
lines.en: I gnaw and gnaw and barely leave a white mark.
I eat what I find; no storing.
Something shifting beyond the bushes.
Not one of us — something else.
I daren't even puff my chest.
My legs are ready to run.
My eyes are fixed that way.
I call once to test.
That shadow is bigger than me.
I back off a step at a time, hugging the grass.
The scent is wrong — dangerous.
I've noted your position.
Don't come further.
I might bolt any moment.
I circle the bush to lose you.
Short legs, but I turn fast.
You're left; I go right.
The grass is too shallow to hide.
My heart is pounding.
I keep looking back at you.
Closer and I'll call the others.
A standoff — who moves first?
I bite your ankle!
Small, but my teeth are sharp.
One bump and I run — don't follow.

lines.zh: 我甩起尾巴，抽你的膝盖。
lines.en: I whip my tail across your knees.

lines.zh: 爪子扒了一下土，吓唬你。
lines.en: I claw the dirt to scare you.
I leap up and butt you.
Don't grab me; I bite.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，咬住你的鞋尖不放。
lines.en: I lunge and lock my teeth on the toe of your boot.
I squeak as I lunge.
I bite and immediately let go.
I poke my head from the bushes.

lines.zh: 这么亮的地方，真不习惯。
lines.en: So bright here; I'm not used to it.
A little dinosaur, quietly arrived.
First, find some grass.
The soil under my feet is new.
No kin of mine nearby.
I call; only wind answers.
First check for food.
Warmer here than home.
Hunched low, I walk on.
Big tracks in the distance.
I'm here; might as well eat.
Flame licks my tail.
A fall from height leaves me dazed.
Water pours down my throat and I paddle wildly.
A roar, and I'm flung over.

lines.zh: 一根细东西扎进我肩胛。
lines.en: Something thin sticks in my shoulder.
A strange force pins me down.
Hunger makes me chew dry twigs.
A flash, and my body locks up.
No bottom below; I keep falling.
